known_limitations.description: Indicator matching is not e2e-verified and depends on feed freshness and observed fields. Managed hash matching requires INTEL_DB; static matching is not equivalent to managed lifecycle enforcement. c2 maps to T1071; malware hash hits have no technique mapping.
Unit/state test sources (not golden-PCAP evidence): services/threat-intel/test_bu3_dedup.py, services/threat-intel/test_lifecycle.py, services/threat-intel/test_ti.py
Measured quality is computed by services/feedback-service/quality.py (KTD2); static confidence weights are not measured precision or false-positive rates.
